newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-Cocoa due up, analysts see rise possible.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Cocoa due up, analysts see rise possible.

text.p: SEPT Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA40
Cocoa has a good chance of going higher, technical analysts said, but they were watching levels below the market that could signal a downturn.
Traders called the market to open around 5 stg higher.
Cocoa has consolidated its move above its March-May range, technical analyst Susan Rigg of Chart Analysis said.
A move below 1,120 stg a tonne on benchmark September would be a "warning shot," she said. But it would be more worrying if cocoa were to go below lows at 1,097.
Provided it held above those levels there was scope for an increase, she added. "There's a good chance it will go forward," she said.
New York cocoa futures powered to nine-year highs on Tuesday as bullish technical indicators and concerns about El Nino fueled continued to spur speculative buying, dealers said.
Benchmark September rallied to a new life-of-contract high of $1,737 a tonne before light origin selling and local profit-taking pared gains. At the close, September stood at $1,713, up $17.
